title: A Memory-Efficient Hierarchical Algorithm for Large-scale OT (HALO)
tldr_zh: HALO 组合层次 warm-start、active 剪枝与一阶 LP 求解器，报告 O(n) 内存与 1024² 图像 8.9× 加速、省 70.5% 显存。
tldr_en: HALO combines hierarchical warm-start, active support pruning, and a first-order LP solver, reporting O(n) memory with 8.9× speedup and 70.5% memory savings on 1024² images.
